name: Lysis, wash and reverse transcription chip
description: Lyses the cells, washes, and runs reverse transcription inside the capsules held in one trap. Parametric parts: modules lysis_rt_trap use the nearest library block as a stand-in (real part and sizing in autochip_part / params). build_chip.py builds the stand-ins at library size; the exact chip needs the autochip layout stage.
source: autochip chip plan spc_single_cell_workflow_assayathon_demo (protocol spc_single_cell_workflow, constraints assayathon_demo)

modules.does: A mesh with 25 um pores holds the capsules while lysis buffer, wash buffer, RT mix and wash buffer are flushed through in turn. They share one water-based reagent_line, with the syringe swapped between steps. The chip sits on a heater for the incubations.

off_chip.why: Index PCR reaches 95 C, above the 50 C limit of the printed resin. The capsules are split into four portions by pipette and cycled in the thermocycler, each with its own index primer mix.
Shell digestion is done at the bench by pipette after PCR.
Bead binding, ethanol washes and elution are done as a bench kit. The lab has no magnet.
Library concentration and fragment size are measured on bench instruments.

steps_text.16: Exchange the buffer for lysis buffer and incubate the capsules.
steps_text.17: Wash the capsules in wash buffer.
steps_text.18: Exchange the buffer for reverse transcription mix and incubate the capsules.
